data_description.tempo_next_color_entity: Used by the 5 am optimizer to know the color for the coming HP period.
data_description.forecast_entity: Expected daily production, used to adjust scoring weights.
data_description.peak_pv_w: Total panel power under optimal conditions.
data_description.grid_subscription_w: Maximum power allowed by your grid contract.

battery.title: Battery
battery.description: Settings shared by all batteries. Leave 'Battery enabled' unchecked if you have no battery.

data.battery_soc_reserve_rouge: Reserve SOC on red Tempo days (%)

data_description.battery_soc_min: Discharge floor on blue and white days. Helios will not draw battery energy below this threshold to power appliances. Increase this value to keep a reserve for the evening (e.g. 30%). The regulation does not discharge below it either.
data_description.battery_soc_max: Charge ceiling. Used by the daily optimizer for simulations. Should match the value configured in your inverter. The regulation itself charges up to 100 %.
data_description.battery_soc_reserve_rouge: Protection threshold on red Tempo days. If SOC drops below this level, Helios reserves the battery: only appliances whose consumption fits within the PV surplus alone can be started. The forced charge the previous evening fills the battery to its maximum regardless of this threshold. This threshold does not limit the battery regulation.
data_description.battery_priority: Relative priority of the battery vs. devices in greedy dispatch (1 = low, 10 = high). Recommended: 7.
data_description.battery_grid_target_blue_w: Grid power the regulation aims at (+ = import). A small positive value avoids exporting.

battery_unit.title: Battery
battery_unit.description: A battery driven in Drive mode. Helios writes the setpoint to the 'Drive setpoint' entity and switches modes with your scripts.

data.battery_neutral_script: Script switching back to the neutral mode

data_description.battery_soc_entity: Sensor returning the battery state of charge as a percentage (0–100).
data_description.battery_power_entity: Battery power sensor (W). Negative = charging, positive = discharging. Used to refine the available surplus calculation.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Total nominal capacity. Used to estimate the power available from the battery to run appliances.
data_description.battery_max_charge_power_w: Maximum charge power of your inverter/battery (W). Required for the daily optimizer to simulate recharging accurately. Should match the limit configured in your inverter.
data_description.battery_max_discharge_power_w: Maximum discharge power (W). Used by the daily optimizer and to calculate the battery energy available for appliances. Should match the limit configured in your inverter.
data_description.battery_drive_script: Called when driving is enabled, then every hour.
data_description.battery_neutral_script: Called when driving is disabled or Helios is switched off.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Add your controllable devices. You can add more later.

data_description.wh_temp_entity: Sensor reporting the current tank temperature.
data_description.wh_temp_target: Target temperature outside off-peak hours, and during off-peak hours on the eve of a red Tempo day. The water heater stops when this value is reached.
data_description.wh_temp_min: Temperature below which the water heater is forced ON immediately, regardless of time of day or solar score.
data_description.wh_temp_min_entity: Entity defining the minimum temperature to reach during off-peak hours. The heater runs until this value is reached in HC, then stops.
data_description.wh_off_peak_hysteresis_k: Prevents short cycles at the start of off-peak periods. The heater only triggers below (off-peak min − hysteresis). Once started, it continues until off-peak min.

data_description.pool_water_temp_entity: Read every day at midnight to set the day's filtration time.
data_description.pool_local_temp_entity: Used for frost protection of the pump and pipes.
data_description.pool_filtration_table: Comma-separated "temperature:hours" points, e.g. 10:2, 14:4, 20:10, 24:12, 28:16, 32:24. Linear interpolation between points, end values beyond.
data_description.pool_wintering_enabled: Switches to wintering when the water is below the threshold at midnight; exits at threshold + 2 °C. While wintering, no time window: filtration on solar surplus, otherwise in off-peak hours before midnight.
data_description.pool_wintering_temp: Water temperature at midnight below which the pool goes into wintering.
data_description.pool_wintering_duration_h: Fixed daily filtration time while wintering: on solar surplus, the rest in off-peak hours before midnight.
data_description.pool_frost_temp: Below this threshold, the pump runs at the start of every hour, even on red days and with the quota reached. Exits at threshold + 1 °C.
data_description.pool_frost_continuous_temp: Below this threshold, the pump runs continuously. Exits at threshold + 1 °C.
data_description.pool_frost_session_minutes: Run minutes at the start of each hour during frost protection. This time counts in the day's filtration.

data_description.device_power_w: Maximum power consumed by the device. Used when no measured power sensor is configured.
data_description.device_power_entity: Measured power sensor (smart plug, meter…). When set, replaces the rated power for budget calculations and base-load estimation.

data_description.sample_interval_seconds: How often PV, grid, house and device power sensors are sampled. Must be ≥ 10 s and ≤ update interval.
data_description.off_peak_1_start: E.g. 22:00 for a 22h–6h off-peak contract. Leave empty if unused.
data_description.off_peak_2_start: Second off-peak slot (e.g. 12:00–14:00). Leave empty if unused.
data_description.ema_enabled: If disabled, the base load profile is frozen and no longer adapts to new measurements.
data_description.hysteresis_w: Budget bonus granted to already-on devices when surplus drops (cloud, momentary overload). Decays to zero over the configured duration.
data_description.hysteresis_duration_minutes: Duration over which the bonus decays linearly to zero. Set to 0 to disable hysteresis.

error.device_weights_must_sum_to_one: The per-device weights must sum to 1.0.
error.sample_interval_out_of_range: Sampling interval must be between 10 s and the update interval.
error.invalid_filtration_table: Invalid filtration law: at least two "temperature:hours" points, distinct temperatures, hours between 0 and 24.
error.frost_continuous_above_sessions: The continuous run threshold must be lower than or equal to the session threshold.
